trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Use the trophy checklist to make a short list of what you still owe, then clear it one item at a time. The description gives no separate unlock action for the platinum, so check it after the other 54 trophies are earned.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: When Gone Fishing appears in your objectives, follow it through to the end. Confirm completion before ticking it off, since fishing on your own does not establish that you finished the named task.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Track Chapter 1 as your first campaign milestone and resume its outstanding objectives when you return from roaming. Leave the trophy unchecked until the chapter ends, even if you’ve just finished a major objective.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: After Chapter 1, follow the Chapter 2 objectives until the chapter closes. Check the trophy at that point so you don’t mistake the start of the chapter for the milestone.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Pick up the Chapter 3 story objectives as soon as you’re ready to advance the campaign. If you stop midchapter, note the pending objective and check off the trophy only once the chapter is finished.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Follow the remaining Chapter 4 objectives to the chapter ending, then check your trophy list. Track the finale separately so an unfinished final mission doesn’t send you back through completed Chapter 4 objectives.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Once you reach the campaign finale, keep following its objectives until the mission finishes. Check the trophy list before starting cleanup, especially if you stopped at a point that felt like the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Watch for Breakfast Run in your objectives and follow the named task when it appears. Mark it complete only when the task ends, since the description gives no credit for similar activities.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Set aside time to play The Cartel Heist through its last objective. Keep following the mission while any objective remains active, even if the main heist action looks finished.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Select Child’s Play when it becomes available and follow its objectives in order. Check the trophy after completion before spending time on a replay for a better result.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: When you reach Headliners, keep it on your checklist until you finish the named task. If you pause partway through, resume the remaining objectives before checking for the unlock.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Follow VCIA Takedown until the named task ends and check your trophy list. Track Catch Me If You Can separately, since its description calls for a departure and gives no confirmed link to this mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Take up Operation Savage Glory when it appears and finish each remaining objective. Use the completion of the whole operation as your checkpoint before looking for additional requirements.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: If the game shows a completion record, use it to list the categories still below their targets. Work through those gaps and check the percentage again after each category. The description gives no breakdown of what counts toward 100%, so keep that record separate from the trophy checklist.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Start a tally of finished stunts and use any visible progress record to validate the first few entries. The description doesn’t say whether repeats count, so favor new stunts until you can verify that a repeat advances progress.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Write down each activity type as you encounter it and tick it off after trying it. Compare labels before counting a new outing, since two locations can offer the same type. The description doesn’t enumerate the types, so add each new one to your list as it appears.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Make a checklist of Shooting Range challenges and put the medal earned beside each one. Use the scoring information shown during a run to decide what to improve on the next attempt. Leave every silver or bronze entry on the retry list until it’s gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: List the locations that offer Top Fun Drone Races and record a win against each location. Start your next race at a blank entry so extra wins at the same location don’t hide a gap.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Write down the event name or identifier after each win. Add to your count only when you win an event missing from that list, and use the resulting tally to find how many of the 20 are left.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Start the fishing challenge with Cal and use the challenge’s shown rules to decide how to play. Wait for the result to confirm you beat him before ticking it off. The description doesn’t specify the scoring rules or any required equipment.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Pick an arcade game and keep playing until its own completion condition is met. The description doesn’t identify a qualifying cabinet or score, so use the game’s end result and check the trophy before assuming an isolated round counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Keep a note of the latest task you finished for Andy so you can find where you left off. Follow his available objectives and confirm you’ve reached the final mission before checking off the trophy. The description doesn’t name that mission or say when it opens.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Group Kenton’s objectives together in your notes and mark each one as you finish it. Use that list to resume his storyline after a break and keep the trophy open until the finale is done. Its title and prerequisites aren’t given in the description.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: When a task for Billy becomes available, complete it and record where you stopped. Follow any later Billy objectives through his finale and verify the trophy afterward. The description doesn’t identify which mission is his last.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Keep a Leonida checklist with one row for each stranger’s mission strand. Tick a row when the whole strand is complete and aim for eight ticks. The description doesn’t identify the eligible strands, so verify that a storyline is a stranger strand before counting it.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Note Randy’s most recent completed task and follow up on his next available objective. Keep the trophy pending until his final mission is finished. The description doesn’t give the finale’s name or its unlock conditions.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Track Tyrone’s objectives as one sequence and leave yourself a note when switching to other work. After finishing his last mission, check your trophy list. The description leaves the exact finale and its prerequisites unspecified.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Sweep Leonida in sections and keep two marks for each spot, one for finding it and one for meditating there. Revisit entries that only have the first mark. The description gives no spot count, so keep a list of places you’ve checked before calling a section complete.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: When you find a hunting objective for Bret, check whether it identifies the unique animal before pursuing a target. Verify the trophy after the hunt before checking it off. The description doesn’t identify the animal, the location, or an availability window.
trophies.missable_note: Prioritize Bret’s hunt when it appears and keep a save beforehand if possible. The description doesn’t say whether the opportunity returns.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Make a missing-card list for each of three sets and update it whenever you add a card. Finish sets with the fewest gaps first if their remaining cards are available. Count a set only after every slot in it is filled.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Mark each location after using WAiNK It there and keep a running total by region. Compare new entries with your earlier marks before counting them. The description gives no location list, so save any uncertain entry for a later check.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: List the challenges you’re pursuing and note what remains on each. Choose a few you can advance together, then tick only the challenges you’ve actually finished. Stop counting when you have 50 completions.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Start an in-game attempt with your partner present and confirm the wanted indicator reaches four stars. Keep your partner with you until the game shows that the pursuit has ended. The description doesn’t identify which scenes let you do this.
trophies.missable_note: Try this while your partner is available. The description doesn’t say when you’ll next have a chance to clear four stars together.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Pick three in-game shops before starting and keep your partner with you through the run. Track the robberies as one streak and start a fresh count if your wanted level clears before the third. The description doesn’t confirm which shops qualify.
trophies.missable_note: Use a chance to do the full streak with your partner present. The description doesn’t say whether you can recreate that opportunity later.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Record the vehicles the game credits as discovered and use that list to spot repeats. The description doesn’t say what registers a discovery, so check any available progress record after encountering a new vehicle before counting it toward 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Wait for an in-game encounter where five enemies are present before using Combat Focus. Start the count when the ability activates and finish all five takedowns before it ends. Reset your tally if the ability runs out early.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Look for an in-game opportunity to depart VCIA and keep a save before testing it if possible. Check for the trophy after each attempt. The description doesn’t define “unscheduled” or name a required mission, vehicle, or departure method.
trophies.missable_note: Keep a save before a possible departure at VCIA if you can. The description doesn’t confirm which opportunity counts or whether it can be repeated.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: If you come across Rhinos in the game, note what you were doing and check for the trophy after any related objective ends. The description doesn’t establish the action, location, or conditions that trigger the unlock, so keep any suspected solution marked as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Start a jewelry store robbery in the game and watch for any indication you’ve been spotted until the objective ends. If the game reports detection, mark the attempt as failed and retry when possible. The description doesn’t specify a store or which actions cause detection.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Track each in-game bank vault robbery and tick it off only once you’ve also escaped. Build the count to five and leave interrupted attempts off the tally. The description doesn’t say whether repeat robberies at the same vault count, so prefer new vaults if you can choose.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Follow the in-game armored truck robbery through the escape and check for the trophy at the end. Keep the entry open if you stopped after taking the loot. The description doesn’t specify a particular truck or escape route.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Divide Leonida into sections and use any visible map or exploration record to mark your coverage. Revisit gaps section by section. The description doesn’t define what counts as explored, so check the game’s progress if it’s available before crossing a section off.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Write the gang’s name beside each in-game Illegal Operation you rob, using ownership information where the game provides it. Cross off each gang once and choose your next objective from those still open. The description doesn’t list the gangs or say how to identify ownership.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach and look for a cocktail option with a view. Check for the trophy after completing the drink interaction. The description doesn’t identify a venue, cocktail, or specific viewing spot.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: If a showroom objective presents a chance to smash your way out, save beforehand if possible and check for the trophy once you’re outside. The description doesn’t explain what “classic style” requires or specify a vehicle, exit, or mission.
trophies.missable_note: Keep a save if the game presents a showroom exit you can attempt. The description doesn’t establish that the opportunity is tied to the story or limited to one try.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley, note the interactions the game offers and check the trophy after each completed attempt. The description doesn’t explain “follow-through” or confirm a throw, score, or other specific action.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Keep a note of prominent partnership moments as you play and check your trophy list when one concludes. The description doesn’t identify the partners, mode, or action required, so leave the entry open until it unlocks.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Keep a separate save before major decisions if the game allows it, and note the option you chose. Check for the trophy after you see the outcome. The description doesn’t identify the relevant choice or say whether a particular result is required.
trophies.missable_note: Keep an earlier save so you can revisit a choice if necessary. The description doesn’t establish a permanent lockout, so treat the flag as a precaution.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: If the game presents a natural retry, record both outcomes and check the trophy after the second attempt. The description doesn’t identify the event or say that you need to fail the first attempt, so avoid deliberately losing progress on that assumption.
trophies.missable_note: Keep a save before a likely retry if you can. The description doesn’t say which second attempt matters or whether the opportunity can come up again.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: If an unusual in-game event stands out, note its context and check for the trophy when it ends. The description doesn’t identify the event, its location, or any action required to trigger it, so keep your note as a lead until you see the unlock.
trophies.missable_note: Keep a save before following up on a plausible encounter if the game allows it. The description doesn’t confirm what to watch for or whether it can recur.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Use the game’s melee drive-by action if it’s available and check for the trophy after the hit. The description doesn’t specify a target type or hit count, so keep those details open until you see progress or an unlock.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After each completed Marked Bills transaction with a contact, add the amount earned to a dedicated tally. Keep other income off that tally and compare it with the $250,000 goal.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Keep a running total of completed shop purchases until it reaches $100,000. Log the amount actually spent each time and check the trophy at the threshold. The description doesn’t say whether each individual shop needs a purchase, so note which shops you’ve used in case you need to revisit that question.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: List the garage properties you find listed for sale and check off each one after ownership is confirmed. Budget for the unchecked entries before spending on other properties. The description gives no total or locations, so keep adding garages as you find them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Follow the Scooter Bros app’s registration steps for each vehicle and record it once the app accepts it. Keep going until you have ten accepted entries. The description doesn’t list eligible vehicles, so check what the app accepts before counting one.
